description:
NSFW mode now distinguishes requested mode from confirmed account settings:

- First toast: NSFW mode on/off — updating account settings.
- Second toast: NSFW mode on/off — account settings confirmed.
- Feed refresh waits for Reddit's successful acknowledgement of both Show NSFW and blur settings.
- Observe the actual account sync result: the Show NSFW setter itself can finish without reporting rejection.
- Further taps queue the latest requested mode; superseded responses do not confirm or refresh it. Failures and timeouts show an error instead of claiming confirmation.
- Preserve the button's owning screen when Compose wraps its handler again during redraws.

The user confirmed that v0.3.7 fixes visiting a profile followed by a nonresponsive toggle. This release retains that fix.

Nine focused JVM regression checks pass. The authenticated Android emulator uses all 18 upstream Morphe v1.46.0 default Reddit patches plus the three custom patches. Both toggle directions received real server acknowledgements without crashes.

Refresh this source in Morphe Manager and repatch Reddit 2026.14.0 with your usual upstream patches.
